messages:
Maya R.: Heads up — a couple of interviewers said their readiness checklist didn’t attach to recent panel invites. Noticed 4 candidates affected this morning.
Samir K.: ugh. same here, didn't get the guide for the 10am panel.
Alejandra (recruiter): I saw an error in the ATS logs around 9:12am: webhook retry loop. ops-bot posted a 429 then gave up.
ops-bot: [automated] webhook delivery failed for /checklist/populate -> 429 Too Many Requests (retry exhausted).
Maya R.: That explains it. Are we sure it's an upstream rate limit from the checklist microservice or from the ATS?
Samir K.: looks like our checklist service got a burst when several interviewers were added to the same job. It throttles on per-customer webhook concurrency atm.
Alejandra (recruiter): For immediate fixes — can we push a manual attach? I don’t want interviewers to show up without the rubric.
Ethan L.: I can run a quick backfill script to re-trigger checklist attach for the affected candidate IDs. Need the list of candidate ids + panel times.
Alejandra (recruiter): sending list in thread — candidate IDs: C-9182, C-9183, C-9184, C-9189. Panels at 10:00, 11:30, 13:00, 15:00.
Maya R.: thanks. Ethan — if you re-trigger, can you also log which webhook responses we got (200 vs 429) so we can correlate?
Ethan L.: yep. I'll run it now and post results. If the service still rate-limits, I’ll fall back to the manual-sheet workaround.
Samir K.: For a longer-term fix, ops, can we: 1) increase concurrency quota for checklist service for recruiting team, 2) add exponential backoff with jitter, 3) add a dead-letter queue so retries don't exhaust callers?
Maya R.: +1 to that list. Also let's add a monitoring alert when webhook 429s exceed a small threshold so we catch it before panels start.
ops-bot: [automated] deploy pipeline:patch/checklist-retries queued by Ethan L.
Ethan L.: quick update — re-triggered webhooks for all four IDs. Responses: C-9182: 200, C-9183: 429 -> retried -> 200, C-9184: 200, C-9189: 429 -> retried -> 429 (final fail).
Alejandra (recruiter): I manually pasted the checklist into the 15:00 panel invite for C-9189. Not ideal but covers it.
Samir K.: noted. Ethan, can you upload the response log to the shared ops folder and add a small CSV of failed IDs?
Ethan L.: done — /shared/people-ops/checklist-backfill/1729501234-results.csv (link pasted in DM).
Maya R.: Action items: Ethan to push retry/backoff patch (PR ready?), Ops to evaluate quota bump, Alejandra to confirm any impacted interviewers got the rubric, and Samir to add alert rule.
Ethan L.: PR created: github.com/redwood/checklist-service/pull/452 — adds exponential backoff + 2x concurrency for recruiting team.
ops-bot: [automated] alert created: checklist_webhook_429_rate > 5 in 10m -> pager to oncall-recruiting.
